definitions.unique_visitors: distinct pseudonymous users in the stated GA4 property and period; identity/consent limitations stated
definitions.page_views: measured page_view events, including repeats; distinguish portal and game pages
definitions.game_starts: first intentional game action for a stated visit/game; reload and restart counting documented
definitions.start_rate: same-population sessions with at least one game_start / eligible game-page sessions, not events divided by users
definitions.game_completions: per-game terminal success definition; not all games have a completion
definitions.return_rate_7d: users in fixed first-visit cohort returning within next 7 days / cohort users with full 7-day followup; partial followup excluded
definitions.search_clicks: Search Console web-search clicks for stated property, game URL and period
definitions.page_rpm: ad_revenue_jpy / measured page_views * 1000, not ad impressions
definitions.monthly_net_profit_jpy: complete calendar month in stated timezone; ad+sponsor+sales minus actual fees/refunds/direct/fixed/payout costs; missing input remains null; no extrapolation from partial month

comparison: After user-approved deployment, compare one change over predeclared matched 14/28-day periods; record seasonality, source mix, sample size and counting-definition changes. No claim of causality from a raw before/after difference.
privacy: No passwords, cookies, user identifiers or row-level personal data in chat/Git; aggregates and anonymous evidence references only.
